preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the string N must be between 1 and 100,000.
The integer K must be between 1 and the length of the string N.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must contain only lowercase Latin letters.
The sum of N over all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output string S' must be the lexicographically smallest string formed by concatenating the subsequences.
